patch.comment: An MCP tool writes a full or read-only disk to the log as an error, as the editor does.

minor.comment: upload_media takes GPX, KML, GeoJSON, ZIP and CSV files, and a list of types in accept.
describe_model names the reference sets, and find_reference_items searches their items.
While a newer content model cannot be read, the tools that write refuse with a message that says why; the tools that read go on.

patch.comment: describe_model says that a coordinates value can have a zoom.

minor.comment: New package: the Mica tools for agents over the Model Context Protocol (2026-07-28, and the 2025 revisions). Agents read the model and the content, save drafts with revisions, upload media, and publish only when allowed.
